issues.detail: The Greek 'εἰς περιποίησιν' (eis peripoiēsin) means 'for the sake of', 'for the purpose of', or 'for the maintenance/preservation of'. The Vietnamese translation 'để anh em được' (so that you may receive/get) changes the grammatical function from a purpose/goal of the calling to a result of the calling.
The Greek 'περιποίησιν' implies 'preservation', 'maintenance', or 'care'. The Vietnamese translation omits this specific nuance, rendering it simply as 'getting' the glory.
